description: This Java source file defines the class 'InboundMappingProcessorActor', which extends an Akka actor to process inbound external messages in the Eclipse Ditto connectivity messaging service. It manages message mapping, handling, and dispatching logic for inbound connectivity messages, including configuration and logging.

classes.name: ExternalMessageWithSender
classes.description: A helper class encapsulating an ExternalMessage along with the sender ActorRef to facilitate message handling and response routing within the actor.

methods.name: determinePoolSize
methods.description: Determines the appropriate thread pool size based on configuration, respecting a maximum limit.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and returns the Akka Props configuration for instantiating this actor with the specified dependencies.

methods.name: mapInboundMessage
methods.description: Processes and maps an ExternalMessage to an InboundMappingOutcomes, handling exceptions and dispatching outcomes.

methods.name: mapExternalMessageToSignal
methods.description: Converts an ExternalMessage into an InboundMappingOutcomes object, representing the mapped signal.

methods.name: appendConnectionIdToAcknowledgementOrResponse
methods.description: Adds the ConnectionId to the headers of a CommandResponse or Acknowledgement, returning the modified object.

methods.name: appendConnectionIdToAcknowledgements
methods.description: Applies the ConnectionId to a list of acknowledgements, returning a new Acknowledgements instance.
